coolmail_soundFile.description: Path to the sound file played when mail arrives.

coolmail_frameCount.description: Number of animation frames to display (if enabled).

coolmail_inbox.description: Path to the user's mailbox file.

coolmail_mailCommand.description: Command to invoke for reading mail.

coolmail_monochrome.description: Whether to run in monochrome mode.

coolmail_geometry.description: Window geometry specification (width x height + xoffset + yoffset).
